title: Updated Title Nest
content: Generate TypeScript types directly from your OpenAPI schema on every build so backend contract changes become compile errors, not runtime surprises.
author: Jugal Kundaliya

title: Why File Storage Is Fine for a Demo API
content: Not every API needs Postgres on day one. A JSON file behind a small storage module gets you a real HTTP contract to build against.
author: Jugal Kundaliya

title: Fastify vs NestJS for a Small API
content: Fastify gives you inline JSON schema next to the route. NestJS gives you DTOs and decorators. Both compile down to the same OpenAPI contract.
author: Jugal Kundaliya
